name: browser-use
description: Agent-plane capability: LLM-driven browser automation. Exposes navigate/act/extract tools backed by the browser-use task API (cloud or self-hosted).
author: Nova

settings.label: browser-use base URL
settings.description: Base URL of the browser-use API. Defaults to the hosted cloud (https://api.browser-use.com); point this at a self-hosted server to override. Falls back to the BROWSER_USE_URL env var.

settings.label: browser-use API key
settings.description: Sent as the X-Browser-Use-API-Key header. Prefer the BROWSER_USE_API_KEY env var over storing a secret in settings.

settings.label: Task timeout (ms)
settings.description: Total budget for a tool call, including polling the task to completion.

settings.label: Poll interval (ms)
settings.description: How often to poll GET /api/v2/tasks/{id} while a task is running.

tools.name: browser.navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in a browser-use session and report the final URL and page title.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to open (sent as startUrl).

then.description: Optional follow-up instruction to perform after the page loads.

maxSteps.description: Cap on agent steps for this task.

tools.name: browser.act
tools.description: Perform a natural-language action in the current browser session (click, type, scroll, submit).

instruction.description: Natural-language action, e.g. "click the Sign in button".

maxSteps.description: Cap on agent steps for this task.

tools.name: browser.extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from the current page given a natural-language query and optional JSON schema.

query.description: What to extract, e.g. "all product names and prices".

structuredOutput.description: Optional JSON-schema string the result should conform to.

maxSteps.description: Cap on agent steps for this task.
